findings.resolution_attempt: Post-round-limit: review_ui_binding requires bindingToken (401 without); store uses constant-time compare; gateway emits ui_binding_token for MCP _meta only; composeProposeMovieToolResult wired on transport.
findings.summary: The model tool list still omits approve and reject, and proposeMovie still clears ui_challenge after storing it. The store is then exposed by GET /gateway/review_ui_binding using only proposal id, revision, and content hash, and Core HTTP permits every request. Those three values are model-visible, so a connected model can read the raw challenge and call approval. buildProposeMovieToolMeta is not used by the server.
Remains resolved. Approval compares the live policy revision with the revision stored on the proposal.

Resolved at 4f0a4e95. Object keys are sorted. Only genres, genre_ids, and countries are sorted as string sets. Character lists and source records keep their selected order, and the reversed-character test expects different digests.
Remains resolved. The click handler reads the current model, origin is checked, and source references are rendered.
Remains resolved. Connector lookup requires the credential epoch to match the account epoch.

findings.resolution_attempt: Post-round-limit: title inserts include synopsis_language (default en); CATALOG_INITIALIZATION receipt stays PENDING until titles commit, then SUCCEEDED 100/100.
findings.summary: Series kind maps to TV, genres are created by label, and an initialization receipt is inserted before members. Title insert still omits synopsis_language, which is NOT NULL and has no default, so every manifest row fails. The initialization receipt is also inserted as SUCCEEDED with counts 100/100 before any title insert, so a failed load leaves a successful seed receipt.

findings.resolution_attempt: Post-round-limit: start.sh exits 78 when SPOOLIN_INSTALLATION or SPOOLIN_LOCK_DIR is unset instead of skipping migrations with status 0.
findings.summary: logs.sh follows only with -f or --follow. When SPOOLIN_INSTALLATION and SPOOLIN_LOCK_DIR are set, start.sh migrates, seeds, then runs compose up. If SPOOLIN_LOCK_DIR is unset, start.sh skips migrations with status 0 and can still return the Compose up status, so a ready exit does not include migrations.

findings.resolution_attempt: Post-round-limit: APPROVE/REJECT audit rows insert on the same connection as approval receipt/publication via AuditInsert.record(conn, ...).
findings.summary: Actor kind for Claude and ChatGPT is now SERVICE, which the audit check allows. recordProposalAuditAfterCommit inserts that row on a second autocommit connection while OwnerReceipts still holds the approval receipt uncommitted. catalog_audit_event.operation_id references operation_receipt, so the insert cannot see that receipt, the audit write fails, and the approval transaction rolls back.
Remains resolved. Credit autosave stores the returned draft version and records an unbacked failure.

findings.resolution_attempt: Post-round-limit: explicit empty/unknown LOG_LEVEL throws InvalidLogLevelException and applyNormalizedLogLevel exits 78 at startup; omitted still defaults to info.
findings.summary: Log messages are now emitted as quoted JSON strings. normalizeConfiguredLogLevel maps omitted values to info and debug to debug, but explicit empty and unknown values also become info. The logging contract requires those explicit values to block readiness instead of being rewritten.

Resolved at 4f0a4e95. spoolin.work.pending reads durable_work rows in READY or LEASED plus pending request receipts. Alert inserts increment spoolin.alert.episodes instead of that gauge. The backlog rule uses that work series.
